notes: Redesigns The Library as an organized private archive using black leather, antique brass, warm ivory text, and quieter cover cards. Cover cards now emphasize title, fandom, ship, and panel position. The archive, single-panel importer, full-wrap splitter, batch queue, settings, and backup screens share one visual system. Full wraps remain temporary source images: only Back Cover, Spine, and Front Cover panels are saved. Existing Save All, Clear All, zoom, drag guides, backups, update checks, and native Windows snapping are preserved.
